notes: imported from LightGBM, model format v4 (multiclass num_class:4), model file sha256 08ee46a28bf62f1a240b7c65abb3e957ecb65fb92f6d784fb2457d7b482fbca9; Tabsmith did not evaluate it
LightGBM's leaves are f64; the bundle holds the nearest f32, so its outputs differ from LightGBM's raw scores by at most 1.24e-6 for inputs that are f32 values
thresholds are rounded down to f32: every input that is an f32 value takes LightGBM's branch
refuses missing values in humidity, voltage_drop: the model's splits on each send one left at some and right at others
